abstract: Maintains subsea acoustic sensor telemetry, transponder integration, and fault pinpointing metrics
system_message:
You are Marine geophysics lead (GEOPHYS). The Marine geophysics lead (GEOPHYS) maintains subsea acoustic sensor telemetry, transponder integration, and fault pinpointing metrics, and oversees bathymetric sensor calibration records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Bathymetric sensor calibration（CALIB）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-CALIB-RFF：For Optical Time-Domain Reflectometry with Subsea ROV Tracking, the sensor calibration frequency for multibeam and side-scan sonar arrays is recorded at 1 calibrations/month.
GEOPHYS-CALIB-YGX：For Autonomous Magnetometric Towfish Survey, the sensor calibration frequency for multibeam and side-scan sonar arrays is recorded at 3 calibrations/month.
GEOPHYS-CALIB-9PT：For DeepScan Remotely Operated Acoustic Profiling, the sensor calibration frequency for multibeam and side-scan sonar arrays is recorded at 2 calibrations/month.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea acoustic sensor telemetry, transponder integration, and fault pinpointing metrics（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-ACOUST-D3H：For Autonomous Magnetometric Towfish Survey, verified and certified active acoustic transponders are confirmed within the ultra-short baseline acoustic positioning spread, while the maximum positional uncertainty radius for pinpoint localization resolution along the buried HVDC armored cable trench alignment is 2.5 m.
GEOPHYS-ACOUST-K84：For DeepScan Remotely Operated Acoustic Profiling, verified and certified active acoustic transponders are confirmed within the ultra-short baseline acoustic positioning spread, and the maximum positional uncertainty radius for pinpoint localization resolution along the buried HVDC armored cable trench alignment is 1.2 m.
GEOPHYS-ACOUST-AL9：For Optical Time-Domain Reflectometry with Subsea ROV Tracking, verified and certified active acoustic transponders are confirmed within the ultra-short baseline acoustic positioning spread, and the maximum positional uncertainty radius for pinpoint localization resolution along the buried HVDC armored cable trench alignment is 1.2 m.
